Cc: program@seedbridge.org
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot credits for Spring cohort — quick question

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency numbers and the model switching options. SeedBridge asked me to confirm what an initial pilot would look like from a credits perspective.

Specifically: for the Spring cohort (6 teams, 8 weeks), would Redwood be able to provide a single promo credit allocation that each team can redeem under VentureLoop, or do credits need to be tied to individual accounts? We have a short deadline for the program launch (March 1) and want to make onboarding as frictionless as possible.

Also, if there are any demo SOW or joint marketing collateral we can include for sponsors, please share.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Community Lead, VentureLoop
olivia@ventureloop.co

----
SeedBridge Accelerator (program@seedbridge.org)
Attachment: VentureLoop_Program_Summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@ventureloop.co>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits for Spring cohort — quick question

Hi Olivia — great meeting yesterday, congrats on getting everything lined up for March. Short answers up front: yes, we can offer pooled promo credits that are redeemable by teams under an umbrella account, and yes, we can provide an SOW template and a short co-marketing blurb.

A couple of operational notes:
- Promo credits can be issued to a parent account and allocated via our console to up to 20 child accounts.
- Credits expire 6 months from issuance by default; we can extend for program cohorts if needed.
- For any startup in the cohort that expects to exceed 1M tokens/month, please loop us in and we can provision a dedicated quota to avoid throttling.

I'll loop in Marcus (payments / credits ops) and Vanessa (partnerships) to confirm timing and the SOW. In the meantime I attached the standard SOW draft and a one-pager for sponsors.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (docx); VentureLoop_MAPlan_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits for Spring cohort — need quick ops confirm

Marcus / Vanessa — forwarding Olivia's note. Can we approve a 6-team pooled credit allocation: 300k tokens total (roughly ~USD 2,500 equivalent), with each child account able to redeem up to 100k tokens initially? SeedBridge wants to keep onboarding friction low and have a single link for redemption.

Questions for Marcus: is 300k tokens fine under our promo budget for a pilot? Any need for a deal ticket or finance approval? Can we issue as a single promo code tied to VentureLoop parent?

Questions for Vanessa: can partnerships own the co-marketing blurb and coordinate logos with VentureLoop? They'll need a one-page describing the pilot benefits.

Thanks — Rachel

Thanks for the ping. Finance sign-off notes:
- 300k tokens promo fits within the regional promo allowance for Q1 (we track by token-equivalent). Approving as a single promo allocation is fine.
- I recommend setting per-child soft caps at 100k to prevent accidental overage; we can escalate to dedicated quota if any team requests more.
- Need a short internal ticket (I created ticket RB-4521) documenting the sponsor, redemption window (issue date to 2027-08-18), and account mapping. Can someone from Partnerships fill that out?

I'll generate the promo code once RB-4521 is in place. Attaching the internal promo checklist to the ticket.

Marcus Lin
